author: Genfeed.ai
description: GenFeed — Electron native app for content creation
name: @genfeedai/desktop

scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun run build:app-shell && bun run copy:app-shell
scripts.build:main: bunx esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=dist/main.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __genfeedCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __genfeedCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --external:electron --external:@electric-sql/pglite --external:@electric-sql/pglite/* --external:@electric-sql/pglite-socket --external:node-pty --tsconfig=tsconfig.json
scripts.build:native: bun run clean && bun run build:main && bun run build:preload && bun run copy:assets
scripts.build:release: bun run build && bun run prepare:release
scripts.copy:assets: mkdir -p dist/assets && cp -r assets/* dist/assets/ && mkdir -p dist/desktop-prisma && cp -r ../../../packages/desktop-prisma/prisma/migrations dist/desktop-prisma/migrations
scripts.dev: bun run electron:install-binary && bun run native:rebuild && node ./scripts/dev.cjs
scripts.pack:mac: bun run electron:install-binary && bun run native:rebuild && bun run build:release && electron-builder --mac --dir --publish never
scripts.qa:release: bun run lint && bun run type-check && bun run test && bun run smoke && bun run verify:bundle-size
scripts.release:mac: bun run electron:install-binary && bun run native:rebuild && bun run build:release && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.smoke: bun run electron:install-binary && bun run native:rebuild && bun run build && node ./scripts/run-smoke.cjs
scripts.start: bun run electron:install-binary && bun run native:rebuild && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron dist/main.js
